north_star: Every serious golfer in South Africa has access to measurement-led improvement.
headline_belief: GOLF IS MORE FUN WHEN IT MAKES SENSE.
mission: We take your golf seriously so you can enjoy it more.
strategic_ambition: Be the brand that knows more about the serious golfer's actual swing than anyone else in South Africa.
human_purpose: Do everything we can to make golf more enjoyable.
category_position: Johannesburg's golf improvement club — the place that understands your game, helps you improve it, and makes you enjoy playing more.

do_not_become: A simulator rental venue (easy to copy, tech is hero, price becomes the argument)
A clinical performance lab (too cold, too intimidating)

should_feel: Obsessed with the golfer, not the equipment
should_never_feel: Clinical for the sake of it
Like every post is trying to sell something
voice.voice_summary: Know the numbers. Speak like a golfer.
voice.operating_principle: The brief comes before the footage.

market_moves.title: Own 'measurement-led serious golf' as a category
market_moves.thesis: No direct competitor in SA owns the TrackMan Performance Studio + 90-day fitting guarantee + measurement-led development stack as a single coherent thing. Create the category — like Red Bull created 'energy drinks.'
market_moves.why_now: The DA gap and 5x SEO ceiling mean we can't outspend the golf-course giants. We can create the category instead. Generic `indoor golf` terms get contested; 'measurement-led serious golf' gets searched by buyers who know what they want.
what_we_sell_psychologically: A clearer idea of what to do next

market_moves.title: Build properties, not random posts (Red Bull move)
market_moves.thesis: Recurring media properties that belong to the brand. Every property sits under one mission: understand the golfer better, then make golf more enjoyable.

flagship_properties.name: The 10-Ball Truth
flagship_properties.purpose: Ten shots. One question. One useful truth. Always end with what the golfer should do next.

flagship_properties.name: Shack Sessions
flagship_properties.purpose: Real people, real bays, jokes, reactions, debates, fitting moments and natural moments inside the space.

flagship_properties.name: The Truth About...
flagship_properties.purpose: Driver spin, lie angle, shaft weight, ball choice, practice, lessons, equipment — useful, clear, never over-technical.

flagship_properties.name: Golf Is More Fun When...
flagship_properties.purpose: When you know your real distances. When your clubs fit. When you stop fighting the same miss. When practice has a purpose.

flagship_properties.name: Member Nights / Shack League
flagship_properties.purpose: Competition without formality. Improvement with a social reason to come back.

flagship_properties.name: Before / After / Why
flagship_properties.purpose: Baseline, change, reason. Show what changed and why it matters to the golfer's actual game.

market_moves.summary_quote: Indoor golf gets them in. Understanding earns trust. Membership keeps them close. Fitting and coaching deepen value.

bets.title: Reclaim the leaked `indoor golf` term
bets.hypothesis: A long-form `indoor golf` landing page (Ogilvy-style) reverses the #2 → #3 slide within 90 days.
bets.evidence_needed: Ubersuggest delta, IG inbound to the new page, booking page visits.
bets.investment: 1 day writing the page + on-page SEO + 3 supporting IG posts.

bets.title: Build the `simulated golf` moat
bets.hypothesis: The #4 position on a 2,400-vol keyword can move to #2 with content + internal linking from the home page.
bets.evidence_needed: Ubersuggest movement, traffic from organic to the simulated-golf landing page.
bets.investment: 1 dedicated page + 1 IG reel of TrackMan sim in action.

bets.title: Launch the `club fitting near me` defence
bets.hypothesis: A Google Business Profile + location page + the 90-day fitting guarantee stops the #4 → #7 slide and pushes back to top-5.
bets.evidence_needed: GBP clicks, organic rank recovery, fitting bookings attributed.
bets.investment: GBP page refresh + new fitting-page content + GBP posts.
bets.source: SEO leak (Ubersuggest 2026-08-26): club fitting near me #4 → #7, 70 vol/mo

bets.title: Launch The 10-Ball Truth flagship
bets.hypothesis: A recurring flagship property (10 shots / 1 question / 1 useful truth) generates 5× engagement vs single-shot content and builds recognition across IG / FB / YouTube.
bets.evidence_needed: Reach per episode, save rate, repeat viewers, brand-recall lift.
bets.investment: 1 day/month per episode + reusable intro/outro + week-of-publish bump.
bets.source: Brand strategy v3 §5 Red Bull move

bets.title: Launch Shack Sessions
bets.hypothesis: Real-people / real-bay / real-moments content builds the warmest part of the brand and earns trust faster than polished content.
bets.evidence_needed: Engagement rate per post, DMs from non-followers, story-completion rate.
bets.investment: In-bay capture day monthly + human edit style + 4-6 episodes/year.
bets.source: Brand strategy v3 §5 + IG data showing human content wins

bets.title: Make membership a relationship engine, not a promo
bets.hypothesis: Positioning membership as the connection point (practice + fitting + coaching + community + repeat visits) increases LTV and reduces churn.
bets.evidence_needed: Membership MRR / churn / cross-sell (fitting + coaching from members).
bets.investment: Membership re-positioning, page rewrite, onboarding flow.
bets.source: Brand strategy v3 §1 history + §3 flywheel Stage 3

search_local_authority.rule: Do not chase giant generic golf keywords just because the search volume looks impressive. Swing Shack should own the category it can credibly dominate: measurement-led golf improvement in Johannesburg.

paid_media_role.fame: Put real human creative and flagship properties in front of more golfers. Build memory, not just clicks.
paid_media_role.demand_capture: Problem-led fitting, membership and coaching offers. Specific problem, specific proof, specific next step.
paid_media_role.retargeting: People who watch, click or visit key pages get a clear action: play, practise, fit, coach or join.
paid_media_role.rule: Do not let cheap traffic run the strategy. Media efficiency matters after the brand idea, audience problem, proof and next action are clear.

scorecard.fame: Are more golfers recognising Swing Shack? — Reach, branded search, direct traffic, recurring-property audience, non-follower exposure.
scorecard.authority: Do golfers believe we understand their game? — Educational saves/shares, fitting/lesson enquiries, search visibility, content questions, repeat viewers.
scorecard.enjoyment: Does the experience make golfers want to play more? — Repeat visits, membership, league participation, referrals, qualitative customer feedback.
scorecard.commercial: Does the brand create profitable behaviour? — Bookings by service, fitting/coaching utilisation, membership value, revenue by source when available.

stop_doing: Stop making TrackMan the headline every time. It is proof, not personality.
Stop confusing serious golfer with low-handicap golfer. A beginner can be serious about improving too.
Stop making improvement sound like homework. Better golf should feel exciting.
Stop relying on daily in-house content capture. Batch it.
Stop asking the designer to invent a new visual language every week. Build recognisable systems.
Stop treating volume as momentum. Twenty posts with one repeated brand belief are stronger than eighty unrelated ones.
Stop launching isolated campaigns with no memory structure. Every campaign should reinforce the same two beliefs.
Stop building tech-feature-first bet titles. Lead with the golfer outcome.

strip.voice_summary: Know the numbers. Speak like a golfer.
